questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Dinitrogen is a robust compound, but reacts at high altitude to form oxides. The oxide of nitrogen that can damage plant leaves and retard photosynthesis is :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{N}_2(\mathrm{ g})+\mathrm{O}_2(\mathrm{ g}) \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{NO}(\mathrm{g})2 \mathrm{NO}(\mathrm{g})+\mathrm{O}_2(\mathrm{ g}) \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{NO}_2(\mathrm{ g})$
Higher concentration of $\mathrm{NO}_2$ damage the leaves and retard the rate of photosynthesis.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Photochemical smog formed in congested metropolitan cities mainly consists of

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The photochemical smog does not generally contain:
questions.solution: Photochemical smog contains nitrogen dioxide $\left(\mathrm{NO}_2\right)$, Ozone $\left(\mathrm{O}_3\right)$, PAN (peroxyacetylnitrate), and compounds containing $-\mathrm{CHO}$ group.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Biochemical oxygen demand(BOD) value can be a measure of water pollution caused by the organic matter. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Polluted water has BOD value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$
Aerobic bacteria decreases the BOD value
Anaerobic bacteria increases the BOD value
Clean water has $B O D$ value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$
questions.solution: Clean water has BOD value less than $5 \mathrm{ppm}$. Polluted water has BOD value higher than $10 \mathrm{ppm}$.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The greenhouse effect is because of the
options: presence of gases, which in general are strong infrared absorbers, in the atmosphere
presence of $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, only in the atmosphere
pressure of $\mathrm{O}_{3}$ and $\mathrm{CH}_{4}$ in the atmosphere
questions.solution: Green house gases such as $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$, ozone, methane, the chlorofluorocarbon compounds and water vapour form a thick cover around the earth which prevents the IR rays emitted by the earth to escape. It gradually leads to increase in temperature of atmosphere.

questions.solution: NO pollutant is the main product of automobiles exhaust.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: When rain is accompanied by a thunderstorm, the collected rain water will have a $\mathrm{pH}$ value:
options: Slightly lower than that of rain water without thunderstorm.
Slightly higher than that when the thunderstorm is not there.
Which depends upon the amount of dust in air.
questions.solution: Normal rain water has pH 5.6. Thunderstorm results in the formation $\mathrm{NO}$ and $\mathrm{HNO}_{3}$ which lowers the $\mathrm{pH}$

questions.q: The statement which is not correct about control of particulate pollution is:
options: In electrostatic precipitator, the particulates are made to acquire positive charge which are then attracted by the negative electrode and removed.
Gravity settling chamber removes larger particles from the air.
Cyclone collector removes fine particls in the diameter range $5-20$ microns.
Wet scrubbers are used to wash away all types of particulates.
questions.solution: Particulates acquire negative charge and are attracted by the positive electrode.
